business_problem: Huatai Securities needed a unified way to aggregate and visualize highly fragmented monitoring and operational data across many heterogeneous securities systems so SRE and operations teams could understand the overall business state, find root causes faster, and make decisions from a single view.
solution_summary: Huatai Securities adopted Baidu AI Cloud's Sugar BI data-visualization platform to build an integrated operations and monitoring view for securities IT. The company connected data from multiple business lines including trading, market data, wealth management, and full-account services, and then organized it across business, application-system, and infrastructure layers. Sugar BI's low-code visualization model lets Huatai pull previously isolated monitoring signals into a single large-screen dashboard, while still allowing specialized SRE teams to maintain personalized troubleshooting pages for their domains. Beyond the command-center view, the same platform is used for routine information collection, operations reports, and ledger-style data work, so visual analysis becomes part of normal operating practice rather than a one-off showcase.

solution_components.name: Sugar BI
solution_components.role: Aggregates multi-source securities operations data into a low-code visualization and monitoring environment for Huatai.

data_flow: Operational and monitoring data from trading, market, wealth-management, account, application, and infrastructure systems are ingested into Sugar BI, where they are aggregated into large-screen views and SRE-specific pages for situational awareness, analysis, and troubleshooting.
business_outcome: Huatai created a one-screen decision and situational-awareness model for securities operations, shortened analysis and troubleshooting cycles, and expanded visualization into everyday reporting and information-collection work without needing a specialist development team for every change.
architecture_clues: The solution joins business-layer, application-layer, and infrastructure-layer monitoring on one screen
Personalized SRE troubleshooting pages remain connected to the central visualization layer
Sugar BI can adapt displays across PC and mobile endpoints
evidence_quotes: Huatai used Sugar BI to gain business intelligence from a monitoring big screen in its digital transformation work (original: 走在数字化转型前列的华泰证券，正在通过百度智能云数据可视化平台 Sugar BI，从一块监控大屏上不断跳动的数据，收获技术运营的智慧).

The platform aggregated full-chain monitoring across trading, market quotes, wealth management, full-account services, and the underlying business, application, and infrastructure layers (original: 完成了交易、行情、理财、全账户等多个业务线的全链路监控，将业务层、应用系统层和基础设施层三个层面…实现了全量汇聚).

When failures occur, teams can quickly narrow root-cause scope and combine the big screen with personalized SRE troubleshooting pages (original: 当某个业务线的故障发生时，也能够快速定位到可能的根因范围，再结合各细分领域 SRE 人员所开发的个性化排障页面).

Huatai chose Sugar BI because of multi-source access, low-code visual effects, fast delivery, and strong security support from the underlying Baidu platform (original: Sugar BI…提供了多种数据源的便捷接入能力、丰富可视化效果的低代码实现能力…百度智能云作为 Sugar BI 底层的平台，有严格的安全标准).
